notices.title: Until Monday 16 November
notices.detail:
As part of the Small Vessel Replacement Programme, port enabling works are required at the Portavadie Slip. As a result, a passenger only service will operate between Monday 19 October – Monday 16 November.

Foot passenger charter MV Due West will operate this service. Please be advised the vessel can only accommodate 12 passengers.

MV Due West departs from the Tarbert and Portavadie Marina Pontoons and not the normal operational slips. Due to the infrastructure at both marinas, passengers must wait at the entrance of the pontoons until met by a crew member. Customers requiring more information can contact Kennacraig port on 01880 280281 (Option 2).

Please note that MV Due West can accommodate bicycles on a first come first served basis.

The following timetables will operate:

Monday – Friday

Depart Tarbert - 07:40, 08:20, 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 14:00, 15:00, 16:00, 16:40, 17:20

notices.title: Until Monday 16 November
notices.detail:
As part of the Small Vessel Replacement Programme, port enabling works are required at the Portavadie Slip. As a result, a passenger only service will operate between Monday 19 October – Monday 16 November.

Foot passenger charter MV Due West will operate this service. Please be advised the vessel can only accommodate 12 passengers.

MV Due West departs from the Tarbert and Portavadie Marina Pontoons and not the normal operational slips. Due to the infrastructure at both marinas, passengers must wait at the entrance of the pontoons until met by a crew member. Customers requiring more information can contact Kennacraig port on 01880 280281 (Option 2).

Please note that MV Due West can accommodate bicycles on a first come first served basis.

The following timetables will operate:

Monday – Friday

Depart Tarbert - 07:40, 08:20, 09:00, 10:00, 11:00, 14:00, 15:00, 16:00, 16:40, 17:20
